streams: streams_unique/manifest.json: distinct PS and Q sampler streams per context/provider/component; min-leg production scales exactly follow the native LHA import.
method: 96 contexts selected by independent deterministic PPS(abs expected S transfer) without replacement within eight ISR/FSR x Rzero/positive x sign cells in raw5-20GeV; 5000 exact stock first-step repeats per context. Q is sampled from the exact native evaluator conditional-Q quadrature nodes/weights; colour and local line ceilings from the original Born are retained. Conditional starting-scale averaging is therefore identical to delta_shower_mean, rather than comparing at the event sampled Q.
limits: This stratified selected-context diagnostic is NOT a population residual estimate. Fixed-sample transfer changes do not extrapolate to the full1M sample. Binomial errors omit context-selection, hard integration, beta and native trial-envelope uncertainties. Any context failing R/D/K/source/mean replay at1e-8 is excluded.
context_bindings: cdf_provenance.json binds each context index/channel/sequence to exact source andmatched paths/hashes; duplicate paths omitted here.
